lines.arrive: The ship of Theseus. Its wood is getting old.
lines.planks: New planks are stacked on the dock.
lines.first: One new plank. Still the same ship, surely.
lines.half: Half of it is new now.
lines.all: Not one original plank is left. Is it still the same ship?
lines.twist: Someone has kept every old plank.
lines.rebuilt: Two ships. Which one is the ship of Theseus?
lines.new_end: You chose the ship that kept sailing. Its parts changed. Its story didn't.
lines.old_end: You chose the original wood. Every plank is the same. But is the ship?
